description: Close your assigned/in-progress attempt ONLY after an explicit request to set it aside. This is terminal: status becomes abandoned, never submitted; evidence and participation remain and shared-evidence access is not revoked. reason=no_longer_needed closes without a replacement. reason=superseded requires superseded_by_attempt_id pointing to your own submitted/scored work. Do not infer closure from inactivity or similarity. For "not today", leave it open. Read history first; explain the consequence before asking whether to close.
